prompt:
Draw the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco at golden hour, viewed from Battery Spencer in the Marin Headlands. Include recognizable International Orange towers with openings and cross-bracing, sweeping suspension cables and many vertical hangers, a road deck spanning the water, blue-green ocean, layered distant hills, warm sunset sky, and subtle low fog. Compose a beautiful detailed landscape at 1200 by 800. Prioritize recognizable bridge geometry, depth and polished visual composition. Do not include text labels. Use no external images, fonts, data, or assets.

Return only a complete HTML document, no markdown fences. Use Three.js to build a true 3D scene out of geometry, not a flat canvas drawing. Import * as THREE from './three.module.js' inside a module script. No other imports or external resources. Set up camera, scene, lights and WebGLRenderer. Render at 1200 by 800, fit the viewport responsively. Provide drag-to-orbit and wheel zoom using native pointer listeners if useful. Use a pleasing perspective camera with the entire bridge visible. Render immediately without animation delays, no randomness unless deterministic. Set window.sceneReady = true after the first rendered frame.
